title: Tool descriptor
description: Describes a CLI tool that has no MCP server. Where an MCP tool definition exists, reuse it and add only the risk and auth fields.

method.description: Native auth method of the tool, e.g. api-key-profile, keychain, oidc.

store_paths.description: Where the tool keeps credentials. Automatically added to the global denied paths.

profiles.description: Profile names that exist, never values.

command.description: Fixed command template. The agent supplies args, never the command string.

target.description: How the harness derives target.environment. The agent never declares it.
